_comment: Catalogue profile for the Pet Centre (Hike POS) runs. Set CATALOG_PROFILE to this file's path to restore the pet-tuned behaviour the engine used to hard-code. With NO profile the engine is vertical-neutral: no signal scoring, no off-domain penalty, no retailer-scoped composition searches, a generic edible test. See docs/engine-briefing.md -> 'Adapting to a NEW catalogue'.
